subject.title: refactor: remove gateway and channel dead exports

question: After an exact-current-main refresh, is the compatibility evidence sufficient to accept removal of these undocumented gateway and channel exports?
rationale: Automation can verify repository consumers and declared compatibility registries, but only maintainers can confirm whether any undocumented deep-import surface is intentionally supported beyond those contracts.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase, regenerate the baseline, rerun the package and compatibility gates, and merge if the exact-head results stay clean.

options.title: Narrow uncertain removals
options.body: Retain any export whose ownership or external compatibility status cannot be established during whole-diff review.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land
recommendation.body: Rebase, regenerate the baseline, rerun the package and compatibility gates, and merge if the exact-head results stay clean.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to both the merged dead-export ratchet and the compatibility-preserving follow-up work.
